**Verification of the change (line 30):**
- `_rest_of_line = r"[^\r\n]*(?:\r\n|\n|\r)?"` — the alternation now tries `\r\n` first, matching the ordering in `_newline` (line 18) and `_end_of_line` (line 29).
- On the error path (line 170), `reader.read_regex(_rest_of_line)` consumes the invalid line's content plus exactly one terminator. For CRLF input, the whole `\r\n` is consumed, so the invalid binding's `original.string` includes the full CRLF and the next binding begins cleanly at line 2.
- LF and lone-CR inputs still match their alternatives, so existing behavior is preserved.
- Repeated invalid lines each consume one terminator, so recovery continues line-by-line.

No further edits are needed; only `src/dotenv/parser.py` was touched.
